recommended.name: Hydrostatic piezoelectric coefficient d_h = 2 d31 + d33
recommended.notes: Implies d33 of about 8.0-8.4 pC/N with measured d31, favouring the kushibiki1999 set (d33 = 8.7, computed) over 6.0 and ruling out 12.5-16.

provenance.original_reference: Graham, Ferroelectrics 10, 65 (1976); confirmed on 9 samples from 5 suppliers, Graham, J. Appl. Phys. 48, 2153 (1977)
